profile.summary: I enjoy using my knowledge and background in Math and Computer Science to solve problems of all kinds, personally and professionally. I am always ready to learn something new and take on the next challenge.

positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Software Development

positions.title: Technical Support Lead
positions.description:
Providing high level expedited support to the Company’s largest clients doing business in multiple locations across the country and internationally
Resolving tickets escalated from Level 2 Support Technicians and other departments
Training Support Team on advanced topics, such as federal excise tax reporting/compliance, advanced software module configuration/troubleshooting, and SQL queries, to expand team knowledge
Developing and implementing Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution times for tickets based on severity of the issue
Contributing to reporting for Support Team Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and SLAs
Collaborating with Support Team Lead and VP of Delivery to analyze ticket data to monitor team workload, ensure SLAs are being met, and plan for future hiring
Collaborating with other departments, such as Software Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, and IT, to improve processes and increase efficiency and customer satisfaction

positions.title: Support Team Lead
positions.description:
Leading weekly team meetings
Overseeing a team of 6 Support Technicians
Working with Company Leadership to ensure Support Team is meeting goals
Interviewing candidates for open Support positions and providing feedback to Company Leadership
Maintaining customer contact data in the ZenDesk support ticketing system

positions.title: Senior Support Technician
positions.description:
Leveraging my experience to expand team responsibilities as the company continues to grow rapidly into new industries and other countries
Acting as an internal resource for training across multiple different departments to grow company knowledge
Resolving tickets escalated from Level 1 and Level 2 Support Technicians and providing feedback on their work
Providing feedback to Support management on team performance and needs
Leading team meetings when management is unavailable

positions.title: Level 2 Support Technician
positions.description:
Defining a second level of Support as the team grows to continue supporting our increasing customer base
Resolving tickets escalated from Level 1 Support Technicians
Performing software upgrades on customer servers
Assisting with testing of new software
Working with 3rd Party Support teams for integrated applications
Training new Support Technicians to facilitate team and company growth

positions.title: Support Technician
positions.description:
Working on a team of 2-3 technicians to support 100+ businesses of various sizes in the use of SAP Business One ERP software and proprietary add-ons developed by the company through email, online ticketing, phone calls, and screen sharing sessions
Analyzing customer business data, including sales, purchasing, production, inventory, and financial data, using reports, ad-hoc SQL Queries, and Excel spreadsheets to identify and correct mistakes in data entry
Troubleshooting and identifying possible software bugs
Creating and maintaining virtual servers for customers in the Amazon Web Services environment

positions.title: Technical Support Advisor
positions.description: Providing technical support over the phone in a call center environment primarily supporting Mac OS X computers with additional training on iOS devices and Apple ID Account Security
